source_refs.note: Exercise 14.1, Question 6: book page 266 (PDF 271); answer key PDF 311 (book page 306).

blocks.prompt: 6 (i) Find a vector whose magnitude is 5 and is parallel to \(3\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - \underline{k}\).
blocks.explanation:
Humein aisa vector chahiye jis ki lambai 5 ho aur jo diye gaye vector ke parallel ho.
Diya kya hai? Ek direction (diya gaya vector) aur ek lambai (5).
Find kya karna hai? Us direction mein 5 lambai ka vector.
Plan: pehle diye gaye vector ka unit vector banayenge (lambai 1), phir usay 5 se multiply karenge. Bilkul aise jaise 1 meter ki chhari ko 5 guna lamba kar dena; rukh wahi rehta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: direction \(3\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), lambai 5.
Humein find karna hai: 5 lambai ka parallel vector.
Tareeqa: matloob vector \(= 5 \times\) (di gayi direction ka unit vector). Unit vector direction deta hai aur 5 lambai deta hai.

Diye gaye vector ki lambai
\[\sqrt{3^2 + 4^2 + (-1)^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{9 + 16 + 1} = \sqrt{26}\]
Kyun: Magnitude formula lagaya: components ke squares jama kar ke square root liya.

Unit vector, phir 5 se multiply
\[\dfrac{5}{\sqrt{26}}(3\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - \underline{k})\]
\[= \dfrac{15}{\sqrt{26}}\underline{i} + \dfrac{20}{\sqrt{26}}\underline{j}\]
\[\quad - \dfrac{5}{\sqrt{26}}\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{26}\) se divide karne se lambai 1 ho gayi, aur 5 se multiply karne se lambai 5 ho gayi. Dono positive numbers hain, is liye direction nahi badli.

Lambai check karein
\[\dfrac{225 + 400 + 25}{26} = \dfrac{650}{26} = 25\]
\[\sqrt{25} = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Naye vector ki lambai bilkul 5 aayi, aur yeh diye gaye vector ka positive multiple hai, is liye parallel bhi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\frac{15}{\sqrt{26}}\underline{i} + \frac{20}{\sqrt{26}}\underline{j} - \frac{5}{\sqrt{26}}\underline{k}\) (ya is ka negative)
Negative wala vector bhi parallel hai, bas ulti taraf ishara karta hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 (ii) Find a vector whose magnitude is 7 and is parallel to \(-\underline{i} + \underline{j} + \underline{k}\).
blocks.explanation:
Humein aisa vector chahiye jis ki lambai 7 ho aur jo diye gaye vector ke parallel ho.
Diya kya hai? Ek direction (diya gaya vector) aur ek lambai (7).
Find kya karna hai? Us direction mein 7 lambai ka vector.
Plan: pehle diye gaye vector ka unit vector banayenge (lambai 1), phir usay 7 se multiply karenge. Bilkul aise jaise 1 meter ki chhari ko 7 guna lamba kar dena; rukh wahi rehta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: direction \(-\underline{i} + \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), lambai 7.
Humein find karna hai: 7 lambai ka parallel vector.
Tareeqa: matloob vector \(= 7 \times\) (di gayi direction ka unit vector). Unit vector direction deta hai aur 7 lambai deta hai.

Diye gaye vector ki lambai
\[\sqrt{(-1)^2 + 1^2 + 1^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: Magnitude formula lagaya: components ke squares jama kar ke square root liya.

Unit vector, phir 7 se multiply
\[\dfrac{7}{\sqrt{3}}(-\underline{i} + \underline{j} + \underline{k})\]
\[= -\dfrac{7}{\sqrt{3}}\underline{i} + \dfrac{7}{\sqrt{3}}\underline{j}\]
\[\quad + \dfrac{7}{\sqrt{3}}\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{3}\) se divide karne se lambai 1 ho gayi, aur 7 se multiply karne se lambai 7 ho gayi. Dono positive numbers hain, is liye direction nahi badli.

Lambai check karein
\[3 \times \dfrac{49}{3} = 49\]
\[\sqrt{49} = 7 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Naye vector ki lambai bilkul 7 aayi, aur yeh diye gaye vector ka positive multiple hai, is liye parallel bhi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(-\frac{7}{\sqrt{3}}\underline{i} + \frac{7}{\sqrt{3}}\underline{j} + \frac{7}{\sqrt{3}}\underline{k}\) (ya is ka negative)
Teeno components ka size barabar hai, sirf pehle ka sign negative hai.
